description: Six pads putting out a gate each, for playing the drone voices by hand or from an external gate source

params.text: Holds its own gate output high; whether it stays high after the mouse is released depends on the latch setting on the menu

inputs.text: Raises its own pad's gate output whatever the pad is doing, so an external source can play it alongside the mouse

outputs.text: 10V while its pad is pressed or its external gate input is high, 0V otherwise

notes: ctrl-click holds one pad down whatever the latch setting is, and pressing another pad releases every pad held that way unless ctrl is held at that moment as well.
ctrl is read when the mouse is released, so a plain press becomes a held pad if ctrl goes down before the mouse comes up.
menu: Latch mode — makes a click on a pad switch its gate on and leave it on until the pad is clicked again; off by default, so a pad is held only while the mouse is down
